description: Manages system-wide permissions, user roles, and access control configurations within the application.

endpoints.name: GetSystemPermissionConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get the entire system permission configuration including all roles and their capabilities
example_uses: Retrieve the complete permission structure of the system.
Show me all roles and their associated capabilities.
Get the initial permission setup for the frontend.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve the full, system-wide permission configuration, typically for initializing a frontend application or for administrative overview.

endpoints.name: CheckUserRoutePermission
endpoints.description: Check if the current user has permission to access a specific route or page

route.description: The route/URL path to check permissions for (e.g., '/partnerships/contacts/123')

example_uses: Check if the current user can access the '/admin/users' page.
Does the current user have access to the specified application path?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to programmatically check if the currently authenticated user has access to a specific application route or URL path.

endpoints.name: GetEntityPermissionDetails
endpoints.description: Get complete permission details for a specific entity, including all possible operations and role requirements
example_uses: Retrieve all permission details for the 'Contact' entity.
Show me what operations are allowed on the 'Partner' entity and by which roles.
Get the permission configuration for the 'Interaction' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to understand the detailed permission structure for a specific business entity, including what actions are possible and which roles are required.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserRoles
endpoints.description: Get the current authenticated user's roles and permissions
example_uses: What roles does the current user have?
Retrieve the roles assigned to me.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to quickly retrieve the roles and basic permission information for the currently authenticated user.

endpoints.name: GetUserRolesByUserId
endpoints.description: Get roles and basic information for a specific user by ID (admin access required)

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve role information for

example_uses: Get the roles for user with ID 'user123'.
Show me the roles assigned to a specific user.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve the roles and basic information for a specific user, typically requiring administrative privileges.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableSystemRoles
endpoints.description: Get all available system roles and their descriptions
example_uses: List all roles defined in the system.
Show me the descriptions for each available system role.
What are the different types of roles I can assign?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a list of all predefined system roles and their associated descriptions, useful for role management interfaces.
